releases.notes:
## DuckyTDM v1.1.0-1.20.1

Bug fixes, new commands, and the Dead team elimination feature.

### New Features
- **Dead Team Elimination** - When a team runs out of tickets, all members are automatically moved to a "Dead" team. Dead players respawn without costing tickets.
- **/duckytdm status** - Check current match state and all team ticket counts
- **/loadout list** - List all defined loadouts
- **/loadout clear** - Remove a player's loadout assignment

### Bug Fixes
- Cannot start a match while one is already active
- Cannot end a match when none is running
- SavedData defaults (ticket count 50, loadouts true) are preserved when loading older save files
- Loadouts no longer apply to teamless players during a match
- Non-player command sources get a proper error message instead of a crash
- /loadout use now requires OP 2 to assign loadouts to other players (anyone can still assign to themselves)
- Internal maps are no longer exposed for external mutation
- Scoreboard objective is namespaced with mod ID to avoid conflicts

### Cleanup
- Removed dead MDK template code from main mod class
- Updated README and description.md

### Install
Drop the JAR into your Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mods folder.

## DuckyTDM v1.0.0-1.20.1

Team Deathmatch mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge 47.4.20.

### Features
- Ticket-based team deathmatch (default 50 tickets per team)
- Loadout system: create, assign, and auto-apply player inventories
- Automatic match end when one team remains
- Scoreboard sidebar showing live ticket counts

### Commands
- /duckytdm start / /duckytdm end — match control
- /duckytdm ticketcount <amount> — set tickets per team
- /loadout add/replace/use/load/remove — loadout management

### Install
Drop the JAR into your Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mods folder.
